title: VTOP Student Portal
aliases: where do I check my grades
how do I register for courses
content: VTOP (vtop.vitap.ac.in) is VIT-AP's student portal for course registration (FFCS), timetables, attendance, grades/CGPA, fee payment status, and official notices. It's the primary source for anything account-specific that a general knowledge base can't answer, like a personal attendance percentage or exact fee due date - always defer to VTOP over a general answer for those.

title: University Webmail
aliases: how do I check my vitap email
content: VIT-AP provides students an official university email account, accessible via the webmail portal at mail.vitap.ac.in. Official communications from faculty, CDC, COE, and the administration are sent to this address, so it's worth checking regularly even if a student primarily uses a personal inbox.

title: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)
aliases: how do credits transfer between colleges
content: VIT-AP participates in India's Academic Bank of Credits (ABC), the national digital system (abc.gov.in) that stores and lets students transfer academic credits earned across institutions, supporting the multiple-entry, multiple-exit option under NEP 2020. Students may need to link their ABC ID during admission or credit-transfer processes.

title: Grievance Redressal
aliases: how do I file a complaint
who do I report ragging to
content: VIT-AP has several dedicated committees for student concerns: the Grievance Redressal Committee (GRC), Anti-Ragging Committee (ARC), Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) for harassment complaints, and the University Disciplinary Committee (UDC). Students can also use the UGC's national e-Samadhan portal (samadhaan.ugc.ac.in) for grievances that need to go beyond the university level.

title: Official FAQ Page
aliases: where can I find answers to common questions
content: VIT-AP publishes an official FAQ page covering common admissions and general questions directly from the university. Worth checking there for anything not covered by Campus Expert's own knowledge base.
